verdict.rationale: Aircall's own docs say its AI Agents answer calls automatically, covering after-hours and peak-volume calls and handling repetitive requests, so the 'answer the line' part of the story is a first-party capability. The pricing page also describes the AI taking actions such as pulling order details and logging outcomes in the CRM. Nothing explicitly shows the AI agent taking a message or handing a live call to a human. Missing for 10: documented AI message-taking, documented AI-to-human handoff or escalation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: AI Agents handle after-hours calls, manage peak volume, and respond to repetitive requests automatically.
pulling order details from Shopify, processing a refund in Stripe, booking a meeting in your calendar, and logging the outcome in your CRM
